patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with contrasting dark and light backgrounds create visual rhythm and delineate content blocks.
A sophisticated, large serif font is used for primary headings, paired with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and subheadings, creating an elegant yet readable hierarchy.

The site predominantly uses a high-contrast dark mode aesthetic with black and white, accented by a subtle light gray for secondary backgrounds and a vibrant orange-to-purple gradient for branding elements.

The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, while all other page content scrolls vertically without additional scroll-triggered animations or parallax effects.

Prominent, full-bleed, almost artistic imagery is used as hero visuals and interstitial section dividers, often featuring a dark overlay or integrated into dark backgrounds to maintain a consistent mood.

technique_notes: The header navigation is implemented as a sticky element, maintaining its position at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll, without any size or style transformations.

Content sections are built with full-width containers, using distinct background colors (black, white, light gray) to visually separate them. Text and primary elements are centered within these sections, constrained to a readable maximum width.
Large, impactful images are integrated as full-width visual breaks between content sections, often featuring a dark, moody aesthetic that complements the site's overall color palette.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) are contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and slightly larger sans-serif subheadings.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle corner radius on buttons and card-like elements, otherwise sharp edges dominate.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of spaciousness and luxury.

standout: The site's distinctive use of dramatic, almost artistic full-bleed imagery, particularly in the hero and subsequent large visual sections, combined with the elegant serif typography and consistent dark mode aesthetic, creates a sophisticated and high-end brand presence that feels more like an art gallery than a typical SaaS marketing page.
